{{Quote|I'm just sorry I never met the Doomed. There not much left of their home&mdash;it's as if their will was protecting their city from the elements.|Varner Hilts|<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith—Spiral 5">[[Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral 5|''Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral'' 5]]</ref>}}
[[The Doomed]], a colony made up of the descendants of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], lived in a small '''city''' on the frigid continent of [[Eshkrene]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. There they kept hidden the [[Oubliette (stasis casket)|oubliette]] that contained the body of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Remulus Dreypa]] in stasis. It also had a [[Eshkrene stables|stable]] which was used to store the Doomed's livestock, which consisted of animals from all over Kesh.

==History==
The City of the Doomed was built by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who had made peace following the [[Great Calamity]], which occurred following the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. They resided there four millennia and maintained a vigil over the Keshiri and the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]]. In [[2974 BBY]], the city was visited by a Lost Tribe expedition which consisted of several [[Alanciari]] [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] and the two [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Parlan Spinner]] and [[Takara Hilts]]. Spinner stole Dreypa's oubliette and awakened the ancient Sith Lord, who launched an [[Dreypa's rebellion|uprising]] against the Tribe in [[Keshtah Minor]]. Meanwhile, the Doomed leader [[Kaliska (S'kytri)|Kaliska]] and Takara Hilts managed to return to the City of the Doomed where they brought the entire Doomed community on a herd of [[uvak]]s to Keshtah to stop Dreypa. The entire Dooomed community were killed during the [[Battle of Sessal Spire]].

However, Dreypa was defeated at the [[Siege of Tahv]]. Following the defeat of Dreypa, [[Grand Lord]] [[Varner Hilts]] sent a second expeditionary force to visit the City of the Doomed. All that they found were ruins since these buildings were only held together by [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] will of the Doomed.
